query:
UPDATE iam.api_keys
                SET name       = COALESCE($2, name),
                    scopes     = COALESCE($3, scopes),
                    is_active  = COALESCE($4, is_active),
                    expires_at = CASE WHEN $5 THEN $6 ELSE expires_at END,
                    updated_at = $7
                WHERE id = $1
